purpose: Ceiling on REAL LLM-visible MCP tool calls, measured through the server tool functions under a minimal LLM policy (call cua_do; on a deferral follow its recovery hint once) on REAL captured Chrome trees (facade/fixtures). Only cua_do is visible by default (the primitives need CUA_TASK_ADVANCED=1). Measured 2026-09: tools were 13% of agent wall time, the driving LLM's turns 87%; a clean booking took 9 mediated calls (native about 5) and the first live cua_do run took 8 because eight tools were visible. Any number changes only with a CE id in changed_by, and that CE's call_budget must record the same number (test_budget.py checks both; CODEOWNERS requires the policy owner's review).

booking_list.description: REAL captured booking page (12 identical Book buttons in a flat AXList): fields+predicates, expect

orders_confirm.description: REAL captured orders table (Track/Cancel per row, AXColumn copies): control, records.identity, confirm label, expect

confirm_deferral.description: REAL orders: dialog without confirm defers with the dialog labels; the follow-up is a second cua_do quoting a label, no primitives

canvas_regions.description: no AX controls; Perception text regions, one chooser call, capture-bound click (tidy synthetic)

large_page_400.description: 80 records, 400+ elements: response must stay small (tidy synthetic)

stale_recovery.description: REAL booking: an unrelated text changes between observe and act; reobserve, re-run, new selection, act

driver_failure_recovered.description: REAL booking: one transient Driver failure before the click, retried inside the call

unknown_then_accept.description: REAL orders: the decoy "Walnut desk lamp shade (replacement)" is unknown for item eq; repeat once with accept_unknown

ambiguity_deferral.description: REAL booking: several eligible records, chooser abstains; the policy narrows the predicates once
